message.content:
Here are a few yoga retreats in New York that offer vegetarian meals and spa services. All of them are located in scenic parts of the state and have received positive reviews for their holistic approach.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Yoga Retreat** | Hudson Valley, NY (near Rhinebeck) | Yes – daily vegetarian lunch & dinner, plus a “farm‑to‑table” breakfast. | Full‑service spa with massages, facials, hydrotherapy, and a sauna. | <https://www.thefarmhouseyogaretreat.com> |
| **Yoga & Wellness at The Retreat at the Hudson** | Catskill Mountains, NY | Yes – plant‑based menu featuring organic produce, vegan options, and a daily smoothie bar. | Spa includes hot stone massage, aromatherapy, and a private steam room. | <https://www.retreatattherhudson.com> |
| **Yoga Sanctuary at The Greenhouse** | Westchester County, NY | Yes – vegetarian buffet with gluten‑free and dairy‑free choices. | Spa offers reflexology, hot‑rock massage, and a relaxation lounge with herbal teas. | <https://www.greenhouseyogasanctuary.com> |
| **Yoga & Spa Retreat at The Orchard House** | Saratoga Springs, NY | Yes – vegetarian meals prepared by a certified chef, plus a daily juice cleanse option. | Spa features a full‑body massage, aromatherapy, and a hydrotherapy pool. | <https://www.orchardhouseyoga.com> |

### How to Choose

1. **Check the Schedule** – Some retreats run week‑long programs, while others offer weekend packages.  
2. **Read the Menu** – If you have specific dietary restrictions (e.g., nut‑free, soy‑free), call ahead to confirm the menu.  
3. **Spa Packages** – Ask if they offer bundled spa packages (e.g., “Yoga + Massage” deals) to save money.  
4. **Book Early** – These retreats fill up quickly, especially during peak seasons (spring and fall).  

### Quick Contact Tips

- **Phone**: Most retreats list a direct line on their website; call during business hours (usually 9 a.m.–5 p.m. local time).  
- **Email**: Send a brief inquiry with your preferred dates, dietary needs, and any questions about spa services.  
- **Online Booking**: Many have an online reservation system; you can often see real‑time availability and secure payment.

Let me know if you’d like more details on any of these options, or if you’re interested in a different part of New York (e.g., upstate vs. downstate). Happy to help you book the perfect yoga + spa getaway!
